name: Miso Paste (Red)
siboNotes: Red miso paste is well-tolerated as it's fermented, which breaks down FODMAPs. Use in small amounts as it's very salty.
preparationTips: Start with small amounts (1/2 tablespoon) as miso is very salty and flavorful
Dissolve in warm water or broth before adding to dishes
Store in refrigerator after opening - it keeps for months
Don't boil miso directly as it can become grainy
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of protein and B vitamins
